claim: `ucontrol move x y` takes four fields, not six. The parser keeps a slot count (`arity`); the instruction only reads a prefix of it.
why: LExecutor.java:344-352 — `case move, stop, approach, pathfind` reads x,y and (only for `approach`) a radius. The `p1..p4` toNumber() calls happen before dispatch, so `uses` is always 1,2,3 even when nothing reads them. Reporting a missing/extra slot against `arity` flags correct community code.
